profile.name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd
profile.group: Torrent Group (Mehta family; also Torrent Power, Torrent Gas). Holding company Torrent Investments Ltd owns all promoter shares.
profile.business: Branded generics in India (5th largest in the Indian pharma market with JB; #1 in cardiac), Brazil and other emerging markets; generics in the US and Germany; contract manufacturing (CDMO) through JB.
profile.segments: One reportable segment (generic formulations). Revenue disclosed by geography: India, Brazil, US, Germany, others.
profile.plants: Formulation plants at Indrad, Dahej, Pithampur, Bileshwarpura, Baddi, Sikkim (Torrent) plus JB's plants; all four plants supplying the US cleared by the USFDA (Dahej EIR received in FY26).

openOffer.note: JB traded above the offer price (the swap ratio implied ~₹1,703 a JB share at announcement), so almost nobody tendered

deal.nclt: Shareholder meetings ordered by NCLT Ahmedabad on 23-Mar-2026; shareholders approved (Q4FY26 call, 22-May-2026); scheme effective 8-Jul-2026, appointed date 21-Jan-2026 (Q1FY27 call, 30-Jul-2026)

jbStub.note: 21-Jan to 31-Mar-2026; EBITDA from MOSL (₹2.4bn, 30.5% margin); PAT from the Q4FY26 call

proForma.note: As if acquired on 1-Apr-2025, net of depreciation and amortisation of fair-value step-ups (AR FY26 note 42F)

deal.financing: ₹12,500 cr raised in Jan-2026: CP ₹1,500 cr (1 year) and NCDs ₹2,000 cr (2 years, 7.45%), ₹2,500 cr (3 years, 7.60%), ₹3,000 cr (4 years, 7.70%), ₹3,500 cr (5 years, 7.80%); backed by a ₹20,000 cr bridge line from HSBC, Standard Chartered and Barclays arranged at announcement.
deal.rationale: Adds JB's chronic brands (Cilacar, Nicardia, Metrogyl, Rantac; ~65% chronic), ophthalmology (Novartis in-licensed portfolio), nephrology and GP reach, a lozenge-led CDMO business and positions in Russia and South Africa; management guided ₹400-450 cr of cost synergies by year 3 (excluding the ophthalmology and Azmarda portfolios), EPS accretion by FY28 and ROCE back to ~28% by FY28.
deal.src: JB public announcement (NSE, 29-Jun-2025); Torrent BSE intimations 05-Dec-2025 and 21-Jan-2026; AR FY26 note 42; Venture Intelligence (19-Jan-2026); Business Standard (30-Jun-2025, credit line); PL company update (01-Jul-2025); Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls; HDFC Sky / ScanX (allotment, Jul-2026)

q1fy27.src: NSE results filing (30-Jul-2026); Q1FY27 call (30-Jul-2026); PL (31-Jul-2026) and ICICI Direct (31-Jul-2026) result notes

jbStandalone.topBrands: Cilacar (cilnidipine), Nicardia (nifedipine), Metrogyl, Rantac, Sporlac; Azmarda (sacubitril-valsartan); Novartis ophthalmology portfolio (in-licensed); IQVIA FY25 ₹2,749 cr (cardiac ₹1,214 cr, GI ₹686 cr, ophthal ₹221 cr)
jbStandalone.src: Screener JBCHEPHARM (fetched 23-Nov-2026; JB's own FY26 results were filed in May-2026); PL company update (01-Jul-2025, IQVIA)

india.curatio: Acquired Oct-2022 for ₹2,000 cr (cosmetic dermatology, 50+ brands); +27% in FY26, +34% in Q1FY27

international.brazil: FY26 BRL 817 mn (₹1,362 cr), +12% in BRL; #1 Indian company, 19th in the retail market; 33 branded and 27 generic products; 58 products awaiting ANVISA approval, 19 filings planned; generic semaglutide (Ozempic) filed, approval pending (others approved Jul-2026).
international.germany: FY26 ₹1,243 cr (EUR 121 mn), -3% in EUR; 5th among generic players, #1 Indian; tender market with annual price cuts; a key third-party supplier (10-15% of German revenue) went out of business; first biosimilar launched.
international.us: FY26 US$151 mn; #12 among Indian generic companies; 124 ANDA approvals, 16 pending, 21 in development; all four US-supplying plants cleared; 17 launches in 30 months worth $20-25 mn; expected to turn profitable in FY27.
international.src: AR FY26 MD&A pp. 151-152; Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 calls

guidance.said: Net debt/EBITDA below 0.5x within 2-3 years; cost of debt below 8%; EPS accretive by FY28; ROCE back to ~28% by FY28
guidance.outcome: Debt raised at 7.45-7.80% (NCDs); net debt/EBITDA 2.07x in Q1FY27

guidance.outcome: FY27 'definitely above ₹100 cr' vs ₹90 cr planned (Jul-2026)

guidance.said: Mid-teens organic growth in FY27 barring a demand shock; field force 7,100 → ~7,500
US single-digit growth for a couple of years; Germany low double-digit in constant currency; Brazil 10-15%
guidance.outcome: Q1: US +23% cc (one-offs), Germany -9% cc, Brazil +3% cc (destocking)

guidance.said: At least +0.5pp a year (Q1 33.3% vs 32.8% for FY26)
Double-digit India Rx growth still possible; international high single to low double digit; integration may dent revenue for 2-3 quarters but not EBITDA
Guidance deferred one quarter until the merged entity settles
No new large deal for 12-18 months; would not exceed 3-3.5x net debt/EBITDA for any deal; India first, mid-size international possible
